title: a2ui.blueprint.json
description: The plan and the state of one A2UI conversion. The agent that does the conversion writes it. The eval harness reads the flows and their test commands from it.

stack.description: The stack id from the detection table of SKILL.md.

sdk_versions.description: Each installed SDK package and its version, as the lock file has it.

id.description: Use _ between words, not -: the test file names use the id, and some test runners refuse - in a file name.

placement.description: Where the surface shows in the app: in the flow of a screen, in a side panel, or on the first screen.

trigger.description: What starts the flow: a prompt that the user types, or a state of the app that the user reaches.

text.description: The prompt that the user types, or the steps that bring the app to the state.

expected_surface.description: The catalog components that must appear on the surface.

test_command.description: Runs this flow's test only, from the app root. The stack file's Flow test heading gives it.

cause.description: Why the flow failed, in one sentence. Only with the status failed.
